messages:
marco: Heads-up — starting onboarding for stellar-40b-lite. Need a quantization bakeoff plan (int8 / fp8 / gguf hybrid) + quick smoke quality checks before we ask infra for dedicated GPUs. target: <=3% instr-follow drop, 2-3x cost reduction target.

anya: Good call. Quick smoke set should include: (1) instruction-following probe (100 short prompts), (2) summarization on 1k docs (ROUGE-L), (3) safety/regression set from evals/safety_v2.jsonl. Keep runs short (sample size small) to rank options. :eyes:

josh: Do we have fp16 baseline numbers? need mem + throughput to estimate gains. Also confirm tokenizer is bpe-compat.

marco: Baseline: fp16 @ A100-40 = ~38 tok/s avg, peak mem 46GB. Tokenizer = rwl-bpe (same as other 40B family).

tess: I'll own the calibration harness and dashboard wiring. Proposed quick command to run calib + sensitivity:```python
# run calibration for int8
python tools/calibrate.py \
  --model stellar-40b-lite.gguf \
  --precision int8 \
  --calib-corpus data/short-instr.jsonl \
  --samples 128 \
  --seed 42 \
  --out runs/stellar/int8_calib_3421
```

quantlab: scheduled job created: runs/stellar/342110 -> https://internal.redwood/models/stellar-40b-lite/runs/342110. Attached auto-eval (instr, rouge, latency). ETA: ~2.5h.

infra-bot: reserved resources: 2xH100 (3h) starting 2026-03-22T13:00:00-08:00 for run 342110. Please confirm slot usage window. :calendar:

anya: Quick plan suggestion: 1) int8 w/ per-channel scale (fastest), 2) fp8 blockwise (if int8 degrades), 3) gguf hybrid: attention heads fallback to fp16 or fp8 dynamic for outliers. For each, capture: latency, mem, instr-f1, rouge-l, hallucination count.

josh: +1 on metrics. Also add pairwise human judgment on top 50 instr samples if any option beats baseline on cost but close on metrics.

marco: Acceptance criteria for canary: instr-f1 >= baseline -3%, rouge-l >= baseline -2.5%, hallucinations <= baseline +1%. If gguf hybrid is chosen, must pass head-level stability (no per-layer noise spikes).

tess: I'll push dashboards to /dashboards/stellar-342110 and add per-run artifacts. Quick checklist: - run calibrations (tess) - run auto-eval (quantlab) - collect perf traces (josh) - human pairwise (anya) - infra slot confirm (marco) - canary config → rollout (product). ETA for first smoke: today EOD.

josh: For calibration, also record activation histograms and max-outlier table. Use:```bash
python tools/collect_stats.py --model runs/stellar/int8_calib_3421 --out stats/int8_3421.json
```

anya: If int8 fails specific layers, try mixed precision mapping: embed+ffn->fp16, matmuls->int8 flagged. We'll enumerate failing layers in the report.

quantlab: Auto-eval summary (prelim): int8 -> -1.8% instr-f1, rouge-l -1.1%, latency +1.2x (smaller batch). fp8 -> -0.9% instr-f1, rouge-l -0.6%, latency +1.05x. gguf-hybrid (attention fp16 fallback) -> -0.6% instr-f1, rouge-l -0.4%, latency +1.1x. Artifacts uploaded.

marco: Nice—looks promising. Plan: run human pairwise on top candidates (int8 vs gguf-hybrid vs fp8), then pick default quant profile and schedule canary. Assign owners in checklist: tess (calib + dashboards), quantlab (auto-eval + artifacts), josh (perf traces + rollout config), anya (human eval coordinator), marco (canary signoff).

infra-bot: Note: please release GPU reservations 1h early if you finish sooner to free capacity.

anya: I'll kick off pairwise sampling now and invite 3 raters. Expect results in ~6h. :thumbsup:

marco: Thanks team — post smoke results here and then we'll prep canary config. :rocket:
